headline: Vermont took its Valcour police dispatch system offline after its vendor reported a potential security incident; no attack is confirmed.
summary: First draft. 10 sources (4 Tier 1), 20 claims (9 Confirmed, 7 Reported, 4 Not established), 5 questions. The state calls it a security incident; no official says it was an attack.
